title: [3.1.0.3-dev-a_a995867cda] Report of 2 bugs - One left
body:
In the last dev versions are two new bug:

Treatments (also reported here https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/2062#issue-1364230359):
- deleting of wrong entry's not longer possible. Delete button and "Remove AAPS started entrys" didn't have any function now.
![Screenshot_20220911-121239](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36486505/189522440-cce8e096-7bd6-47cf-88bc-8f62523e0177.png)

Messages:
- messages, that comes up if you enter wrong values (basal, isf...) shows only a white box. There is a white background with also white letters.
![Screenshot_20220911-121310](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36486505/189522460-d28950d5-eb1c-47ed-b547-c0663c5c31de.png)

@MilosKozak 
if you are aware of this bugs, you can close this issue.

My System:
Pixel 5 Dark Mode, DanaRS, Dexcom G6 with Boyda, latest Dev AAPS.
